quality_masks.delta_dense_lsq: all-frame official vis; a stricter mask, so this is a complete estimator comparison, not a pure fitting-rule effect

sensitivity_only: actual future dt for CV and surface; D unchanged
population: all original points, all valid objects; zero fallback and covered-CV hybrids
input_change: add all 5-7 real frames in same original endpoint interval; not equal-input improvement over O
fit: current-anchored unweighted LSQ with actual timestamps; report endpoint and LSQ separately
comparisons: dense endpoint vs T2: matched queries/depth/endpoints/population, added frames
dense LSQ vs dense endpoint: report both unfiltered/quality and support fractions; masks can differ
both against retained CRN-CV and CV+D
decision: No O integration based on tiny moving-only gain; require useful moving gain with controlled stationary error relative to strong CV+D. If no favorable tradeoff, stop external 3D velocity expansion and implement task-readable future-state competitor.
